_comment: Opt-in publication vocabulary for THIS repo. The hunch package ships no term list — a list tuned to one project's prose fires on another project's ordinary engineering writing. Patterns are JS regex source, matched case-insensitively against PROSE fields only (never ids, paths or evidence). Advisory: a match prints a warning naming the matched text, it never blocks a capture. Patterns that would themselves be sensitive to publish (anything naming specific companies or products) belong in the gitignored .hunch/publication.local.json, which is merged on top of this file.
